Name: Shie-Esque Leo Portrait
Author: Stephamoeba
Description:
This portrait mod imitates Shielia's art style from their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264]SHIE'S PORTRAITS[/url] mod.
It's important to note that Leo's portrait uses an arrangement of Shielia's portrait mod (It uses the child head base from Jas and Vincent).

Shielia is currently working on their own official portraits for the 1.5 update, but [b]they have graciously allowed me to post this[/b]!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264]Again, please download and support the official mod![/url]


[b]MOD REQUIREMENTS[/b]:
[list]
[*]Content Patcher
[*]SMAPI (Stardew Modding API)
[*]PyTK (Platonymous Toolkit)
[*]SHIE'S PORTRAITS
[/list]

[b]INSTALLATION GUIDE[/b]:
Simply download the zip folder, unzip it, and place the unzipped folder within your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
([u]Example[/u]: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)

Downloads.Description: Download and place inside your Stardew Valley Mods folder
